route: Permit for recruiting foreign labour (Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation), then an entry visa for residence and work (Decree No. 212 of 2009; Labour Relations Law No. 12 of 2010)

permit.applies: The engaging entity (the project or employer) obtains the recruitment permit; the visa is issued by the General Department of Passports, Nationality and Foreigner Affairs; the worker registers on the Wafed Digital Platform
permit.first: Verification that no capable Libyan can fill the post; an employment contract under Law No. 12 of 2010, authenticated by the Employment Administration

sources.title: Libya Security Sector Legislation database (DCAF), General People's Committee Decree No. (212) of 1377 FDP (2009 AD), English translation
sources.said: Entry visas for the purpose of residence and work shall be issued on the basis of a permit for recruiting foreign labour issued by the Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation in accordance with the prescribed procedures. … Permits for recruiting labour shall be issued for the entity in charge of the project and shall contain the required number of people that are to be recruited, their specialisations and the country of recruitment. In all cases, the lack of a capable Libyan person to fulfil the position or job for which the foreigner is being recruited must be verified.

sources.title: Lawsociety.ly, Announcement of the Ministry of Labor and Rehabilitation of 2025 regarding the regularization of the legal status of foreign workers (12 February 2025); rests on the Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation's circular of 12 February 2025
sources.said: Registration on the “Wafed Digital Platform” via the online portal: wafed.gov.ly . Signing an Employment Contract between the worker and the employer by Labor Relations Law No. (12) of 2010 and its executive regulations. The contract must be authenticated by the Employment Administration

blockers.sought: the recruitment permit's and the work visa's fees (Decision No. 137 of 2024 amended visa fees)
